shortBulletSummary: The crypto market's Fear & Greed Index is currently at 54, indicating a neutral sentiment.
Cooler July CPI and weaker jobs data have reduced the odds of a September Fed rate hike.
Persistent geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz are weighing on Bitcoin's risk sentiment.
Altcoins, including Solana and Dogecoin, are showing stronger percentage gains compared to Bitcoin.
